newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wing Fai to issue shrs for property firms.
newsitem.headline: Wing Fai to issue shrs for property firms.

text.p: Wing Fai International Ltd said it agreed to buy China Rich International Investments Holdings Ltd and an 88-percent stake in China Rich Properties Ltd from Fitzroya International Holdings Ltd for HK$275 million.
The consideration also included the purchase of a shareholder's loan of HK$44 million owed by China Rich to Fitzeryo, the companies said in a joint statement.

Wing Fai would issue a total of 639.53 million new shares at HK$0.43 each to Fitzroya to satisfy the consideration, and the share issue would boost Fitzroya's and related parties' holding in Wing Fai to 82 percent, they said.
Fitzroya's Central Securities Holdings Ltd is a substantial shareholder of Wing Fai and currently holds a stake of 29.03 percent in Wing Fai, a civil engineering concern.

The companies also said agreements would be made with Lippo Securities Ltd following the close of the offer to ensure that not less than 25 percent of the company's enlarged issued share capital and warrants would be held by the public.

Under the requirements of Hong Kong's takeovers and mergers code, a possible unconditional cash offer would be made by Central Securities to shareholders of Wing Fai on the bas is of HK$0.43 in cash per share and HK$0.04 in cash per warrant.
The offer price for the shares represented a discount of 18.9 percent to the HK$0.53 closing price on March 14 and a 53.5 percent discount to HK$0.086 for the warrants.
Wing Fai shares were up HK$0.20 to HK$0.55 at midday after trading resumed on Wednesday.

China Rich Properties, a Hong Kong based company, is principally engaged in property holding and development in China while China Rich Investment provides property management and agency services to China Rich Properties.
